name: island-estate
description: 私人海岛庄园 three.js 场景：程序化地形、写实植被、第一人称漫游

scripts.check: npm run build && npm run test:terrain && npm run test:invariants && npm run test:baselines && npm run test:regression && npm run test:visual && npm run patrol:quick && python3 tests/scene_audit.py --strict
